text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future risk and return, not by whether it is above or below my personal purchase price; avoiding a sale to dodge admitting a mistake can prolong a bad decision.","Buying several stocks at once does not guarantee diversification or safety; I should check position sizes and the account’s overall exposure before committing cash.","After a sharp account decline, I should review my reasons and risk limits rather than either panic-selling or passively holding just to avoid realizing a loss."]}
